description: This file implements the PID controller class (`Pid`) and a cascaded integrator-derivative controller subclass (`PidCic`) for use in firmware, including methods for calculation, parameter updates, state reporting, and sleep management.

classes.name: Pid
classes.description: A class implementing a PID controller with adjustable parameters, state management, and optional debugging features.

classes.name: PidCic
classes.description: A subclass of Pid implementing a cascaded integrator-accumulator control algorithm for smoother I-term handling.

methods.name: Pid::getValue
methods.description: Calculates the PID controller output value based on target and input, considering current parameters.

methods.name: Pid::updateFactors
methods.description: Updates the PID gains (P, I, D) and resets the internal state.

methods.name: Pid::reset
methods.description: Resets internal state variables including previous errors and integrals.

methods.name: Pid::getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset added to the control output.

methods.name: Pid::setErrorAmplification
methods.description: Sets a coefficient to amplify the error term.

methods.name: Pid::sleep
methods.description: Pauses execution for a period based on the PID period setting.

methods.name: Pid::showPidStatus
methods.description: Outputs current PID settings and status information through a logging interface.

methods.name: PidCic::reset
methods.description: Resets the cascaded integrator state and buffer for the CIC filtering.

methods.name: PidCic::getValue
methods.description: Returns the current control value, using CIC-based I-term filtering.

methods.name: PidCic::updateITerm
methods.description: Updates the I-term using a CIC filtering method to prevent overflow and smooth the control action.
